"""Read-only independent audit of frozen fixture vs original model and optional Ceres residuals."""
import argparse, hashlib, json, math, struct, sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
from audit_colmap_pinhole_model import rotation
ap=argparse.ArgumentParser()
ap.add_argument("--fixture",type=Path,required=True)
ap.add_argument("--model",type=Path,required=True)
ap.add_argument("--rig",type=Path,required=True)
ap.add_argument("--dump",type=Path,required=True)
args=ap.parse_args()
def tokens(path):
 with path.open() as stream:
  for line in stream:
   if line.strip() and not line.lstrip().startswith("#"): yield line.split()
def rigid(v):
 return np.array(rotation(v[:4])), np.array(list(map(float,v[4:7])))
def close(a,b,atol=1e-12): assert np.allclose(a,b,rtol=1e-12,atol=atol),(a,b)
camera_rows={int(v[0]):v for v in tokens(args.model/"cameras.txt")}
sensors={}; assignment={}
for v in tokens(args.rig):
 if v[0]=="S": sensors[int(v[1])]=v
 elif v[0]=="F": assignment[v[2]]=(int(v[1]),int(v[3]))
 else: raise AssertionError(v[0])
images={}
with (args.model/"images.txt").open() as stream:
 for line in stream:
  if not line.strip() or line.lstrip().startswith("#"): continue
  h=line.split(); kp=next(stream).split(); images[int(h[0])]=(h,kp)
source_points={int(v[0]):np.array(list(map(float,v[1:4]))) for v in tokens(args.model/"points3D.txt")}
source_poses={}
for iid,(h,kp) in images.items():
 frame,sensor=assignment[h[9]]
 if sensor!=0: continue
 rs,ts=rigid(sensors[sensor][9:16]); ri,ti=rigid(h[1:8])
 source_poses[frame]=(rs.T@ri,rs.T@(ti-ts))
def expected_observations():
 for v in tokens(args.model/"points3D.txt"):
  point=int(v[0])
  for k in range(8,len(v),2):
   iid,idx=int(v[k]),int(v[k+1]); h,kp=images[iid]
   assert int(kp[3*idx+2])==point
   frame,sensor=assignment[h[9]]
   yield frame,point,int(h[8]),float(kp[3*idx]),float(kp[3*idx+1]),sensor
dump_header={}
def dump_rows():
 for v in tokens(args.dump):
  if v[0]=="OBSERVATION":
   assert len(v)==9,v
   yield v
  elif v[0]!="OBSERVATION_INDEX":
   assert v[0] not in dump_header,v[0]
   dump_header[v[0]]=" ".join(v[1:])
dump_iter=iter(dump_rows())
max_residual_difference=max_depth_difference=0.0
dump_cost=0.0
expected=iter(expected_observations())
poses={}; points={}; cameras={}; fixed=[]; header={}; nobs=0; cost=0.0
min_depth=math.inf; max_depth=0.0
residual_hash=hashlib.sha256()
ended=False
for v in tokens(args.fixture):
 tag=v[0]
 if tag=="POSE":
  key=int(v[1]); assert key not in poses; poses[key]=rigid(v[2:])
  rp,tp=source_poses[key]; close(poses[key][0],rp); close(poses[key][1],tp)
 elif tag=="FIXED_POSE": fixed.append(int(v[1]))
 elif tag=="LANDMARK":
  key=int(v[1]); assert key not in points; points[key]=np.array(list(map(float,v[2:5])))
  assert np.array_equal(points[key],source_points[key])
 elif tag=="CAMERA":
  key=int(v[1]); assert key not in cameras
  original=camera_rows[key]; assert v[2]=="PINHOLE"==original[1] and v[5]=="4"
  assert list(map(int,v[3:5]))==list(map(int,original[2:4]))
  cameras[key]=tuple(map(float,v[6:10])); assert cameras[key]==tuple(map(float,original[4:8]))
 elif tag=="RIG_OBSERVATION":
  frame,point=int(v[1]),int(v[2]); x,y=float(v[3]),float(v[4]); camera=int(v[5])
  ef,ep,ec,ex,ey,sensor=next(expected)
  assert (frame,point,camera,x,y)==(ef,ep,ec,ex,ey)
  rs,ts=rigid(v[6:13]); sr=sensors[sensor]; er,et=rigid(sr[9:16])
  close(rs,er); close(ts,et); assert camera==int(sr[2])
  rp,tp=poses[frame]; xyz=rs@(rp@points[point]+tp)+ts
  assert np.all(np.isfinite(xyz)) and xyz[2]>0
  fx,fy,cx,cy=cameras[camera]; rx=fx*xyz[0]/xyz[2]+cx-x; ry=fy*xyz[1]/xyz[2]+cy-y
  assert math.isfinite(rx) and math.isfinite(ry)
  vout=next(dump_iter)
  assert tuple(map(int,vout[1:5]))==(nobs,frame,point,camera)
  ax,ay,az,acost=map(float,vout[5:9])
  assert all(map(math.isfinite,[ax,ay,az,acost])) and az>0
  for actual,ref in [(ax,rx),(ay,ry)]:
   delta=abs(actual-ref); max_residual_difference=max(max_residual_difference,delta)
   assert delta<=1e-6+1e-12*abs(ref),(nobs,actual,ref)
  dz=abs(az-float(xyz[2])); max_depth_difference=max(max_depth_difference,dz)
  assert dz<=1e-9+1e-12*abs(float(xyz[2]))
  assert abs(acost-(ax*ax+ay*ay))<=1e-10+1e-12*abs(acost)
  dump_cost+=acost
  cost+=rx*rx+ry*ry; min_depth=min(min_depth,float(xyz[2])); max_depth=max(max_depth,float(xyz[2]))
  residual_hash.update(struct.pack("<QQQQddd",nobs,frame,point,camera,rx,ry,float(xyz[2])))
  nobs+=1
 elif tag=="END": ended=True
 else:
  assert tag not in header,tag
  header[tag]=" ".join(v[1:])
assert ended and next(expected,None) is None
assert next(dump_iter,None) is None
assert dump_header["VISLOC_BA_EVALUATION"]=="1"
assert dump_header["SOURCE_SHA256"]==header["SOURCE_SHA256"]
for label in ["CAMERAS","IMAGES","POINTS","MANIFEST"]:
 assert dump_header["SOURCE_SHA256_"+label]==header["SOURCE_SHA256_"+label]
assert float(dump_header["DECLARED_INITIAL_COST"])==float(header["INITIAL_COST"])
assert dump_header["DECLARED_INITIAL_COST_BITS"]==header["INITIAL_COST_BITS"]
assert dump_header["CERES_VERSION"]=="2.2.0"
assert dump_header["FIXED_POSE"]=="0"
assert dump_header["SUMMARY_OBSERVATIONS"]=="130900" and dump_header["SUMMARY_POSITIVE_DEPTH"]=="130900"
assert abs(float(dump_header["SUMMARY_SQUARED_COST"])-dump_cost)<=1e-6+1e-10*abs(dump_cost)
assert abs(dump_cost-cost)<=1e-6+1e-10*abs(cost)
assert set(poses)==set(source_poses) and set(points)==set(source_points)
assert fixed==[0]
assert (len(poses),len(points),nobs,len(cameras))==(500,4716,130900,2)
assert header["POSE_COUNT"]=="500" and header["LANDMARK_COUNT"]=="4716" and header["OBSERVATION_COUNT"]=="130900"
initial=float(header["INITIAL_COST"])
assert struct.unpack("<Q",struct.pack("<d",initial))[0]==int(header["INITIAL_COST_BITS"])
assert abs(cost-initial)<=1e-6+1e-10*abs(initial)
checks={}
for label,path in [("CAMERAS",args.model/"cameras.txt"),("IMAGES",args.model/"images.txt"),("POINTS",args.model/"points3D.txt"),("MANIFEST",args.rig)]:
 digest=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 assert digest==header["SOURCE_SHA256_"+label]
 checks[str(path)]=digest
print(json.dumps({"ceres_dump":str(args.dump),"ceres_dump_sha256":hashlib.sha256(args.dump.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"ceres_squared_cost":dump_cost,"max_residual_coordinate_difference_px":max_residual_difference,"max_depth_difference_m":max_depth_difference,"dump_header":dump_header,"fixture":str(args.fixture),"fixture_sha256":hashlib.sha256(args.fixture.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"source_hashes":checks,"poses":len(poses),"landmarks":len(points),"observations":nobs,"cameras":len(cameras),"fixed_poses":fixed,"full_observation_identity_order_xy_exact":True,"full_landmark_identity_xyz_exact":True,"camera_parameters_exact":True,"pose_and_sensor_transform_parity":True,"initial_squared_cost":initial,"independent_squared_cost":cost,"squared_cost_absolute_difference":abs(cost-initial),"initial_cost_bits":int(header["INITIAL_COST_BITS"]),"min_depth_m":min_depth,"max_depth_m":max_depth,"independent_residual_stream_binary_sha256":residual_hash.hexdigest()},indent=2))
